caseNameFull: MINNESOTA VOTERS ALLIANCE v. Joe MANSKY

opinions.text: Motion of Cato Institute, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of the American Civil Rights Union, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Center for Competitive Politics for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted.
